DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車がなくなったのはどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did your bicycle disappear from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅近くの駐輪場です。止めた所の横に、切れたワイヤーの鍵が落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車の不在と切れた鍵を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle parking area near the station. A cut cable lock was lying beside where I parked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the missing bicycle and the cut lock. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その鍵をご自身の物と分かる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there any features that identify the lock as yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青いカバーに白いテープを巻いています。落ちていた鍵にも同じテープがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵を識別できる加工を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrapped white tape around its blue cover. The lock on the ground had the same tape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the modification that identifies your lock. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現場の物は動かしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you move anything at the scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かしていません。写真だけ撮りましたが、鍵を拾って持って来た方がよかったですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場を動かさず写真を撮ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I only took photos. Should I have picked up the lock and brought it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you took photos without moving anything at the scene. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今はそのままで結構です。場所を確認できる写真も拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is fine to leave it as it is for now. We will also look at photos showing the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。駐輪番号は十二番で、昨夜九時には自転車がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駐輪位置と最後に見た時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. It was parking space twelve, and the bicycle was there at nine last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the parking location and when you last saw it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今朝見当たらなかった時刻と、自転車の情報もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us when you noticed it missing this morning and the bicycle's details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝七時です。登録番号の控えを家から持って来られます。まず写真と時刻で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時刻と追加できる登録情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Seven this morning. I can bring the registration number record from home. First I would like advice based on the photos and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the discovery time and registration information you can add. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。分かる情報でお話を伺い、追加資料についてもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hear what you know and explain about additional documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りですね。お急ぎでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending this envelope, correct? Is it urgent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日が締切です。今日出せば今日の消印になるので間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 締切に間に合うか消印を根拠に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The deadline is tomorrow. If I send it today, it gets today's postmark, so will it be in time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it will meet the deadline based on the postmark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに「明日必着」とあります。消印が明日までという意味ではないんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必着の文言の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says it must arrive tomorrow. Doesn't that mean the postmark must be no later than tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what “must arrive” means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必着は提出先へ届く期限です。消印の日とは別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is the deadline for arrival at the recipient. It differs from the postmark date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、今日出しただけでは間に合うと決められませんね。到着の見込みを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送日と到着期限の違いを理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then sending it today alone does not establish that it will be in time. I want to check the expected arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand the difference between sending date and arrival deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先と今の受付時刻でお調べします。ただ、提出先での受付条件もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check based on the address and current acceptance time. Please also confirm the recipient's submission conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出先には持参できるかも聞きます。今は料金を払う前に、配送の案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金支払い前に配送と持参の可能性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also ask the recipient whether I can bring it in person. For now, please explain delivery before I pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check delivery and the possibility of bringing it in person before paying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この宛先では明日到着をお約束できません。別の提出方法を先に相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot promise arrival tomorrow at this address. Would you like to discuss another submission method first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。提出先へ連絡するまで発送を保留します。封筒は返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着保証がないため発送を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will hold off sending until I contact the recipient. Please give me the envelope back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off sending because arrival is not guaranteed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しします。方法が決まってから、必要なら改めてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here it is. Once you decide on a method, bring it again if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座のご相談ですね。ご本人から利用目的を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a new account. May I ask you personally what you intend to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社の給料を受け取るためです。さっきは同僚が説明しましたが、私が答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の給与受取目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. To receive my salary from my company. My coworker explained earlier, but I will answer myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your own purpose of receiving salary. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お給料のほかに、予定している利用はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you plan any uses besides salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃の支払いにも使いたいです。海外への送金は、今は予定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定する支払いと送金予定の有無を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also want to use it to pay rent. I have no plans for overseas transfers at present.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State planned payments and whether you plan transfers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な確認はご本人にお願いします。会社から受け取った案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to confirm the required matters with you personally. Do you have instructions from your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この紙があります。支店名が指定されているようなので、ここで申し込めるか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の支店指定と思った資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this paper. It seems to specify a branch name. Please check whether I can apply here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the document you thought specified a company-designated branch. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この記載は給与担当への提出欄です。口座開設を保証する書類ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This part is for submission to payroll staff. It is not a document guaranteeing account opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申込みと会社への届け出は別ですね。開設に必要な書類は自分で準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開設手続きと会社への届出を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The account application and notification to the company are separate, right? I will prepare the required opening documents myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish account-opening procedures from notification to the company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、確認項目と必要書類をお渡しします。今日はお持ちの書類も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will give you the confirmation items and required documents. Let's also check the documents you brought today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。同僚は説明を聞く手伝いだけで、口座の管理やカードの保管は私がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理と保管を本人が行うと明言する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. My coworker only helps me listen to the explanation; I will manage the account and keep the card myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State clearly that you personally will manage the account and keep the card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の希望として記録し、手続きについてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record that as your own wishes and explain the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お肉の値段についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the meat price?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚には百八十円とあるのに、パックには五百四十円とあります。値札が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の単価とパック総額の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelf says 180 yen, but the pack says 540 yen. Is the price label wrong?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between shelf unit price and total pack price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の表示は百グラム当たりです。このパックは三百グラムあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shelf price is per 100 grams. This pack contains 300 grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三倍の量だから五百四十円なんですね。今日は一人分なので、もっと少ない物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要量を伝えて少量を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is 540 yen because it is three times the quantity. It is just for one person today; do you have less?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the amount you need and look for a small portion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに百五十グラム入りがあります。同じ単価です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is a 150-gram pack. It has the same unit price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では二百七十円ですね。ただ、こちらは脂が多そうですが、同じ部位ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量品の部位も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then it is 270 yen. But this one looks fattier. Is it the same cut?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the cut of the smaller portion too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは別の部位です。単価は同じですが、料理に向く使い方が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is a different cut. The unit price is the same, but it suits different ways of cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 炒め物に使います。最初の部位で少量のパックがあるか探してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理に合う元の部位で少量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use it for a stir-fry. Could you find a small pack of the original cut?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a small portion of the original cut suitable for your dish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに二百グラム入りが一つありました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それにします。総額の三百六十円を確認して、元のパックは棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額を確認し買うパックを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take that. I will check the total of 360 yen and return the original pack to the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the total and choose which pack to buy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらのパックをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take this pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の地図をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the walking map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。杖を使っているので、途中で座れる道を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杖で歩ける休憩付きの道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I use a cane, so I want a route where I can sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a route you can walk with a cane and resting places. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口から右の園路にはベンチがあります。背もたれが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are benches on the path to the right from the entrance. Do you need a backrest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 必要です。立ち上がる時も使いたいので、腰掛けが低すぎない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要な背もたれと座面を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to use it when standing up too. Is there a seat that is not too low?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the backrest and seat you need. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理棟の横のベンチを見て、使いやすいかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Look at the bench beside the management building and check whether it is easy for you to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まずそこまで歩きます。杖を背中側に置くと忘れそうなので、手元に置いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 杖を手元に置く可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk there first. If I put my cane behind me, I may forget it. Is it okay to keep it within reach?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can keep your cane at hand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路へ突き出ないよう、そばに収めてください。倒れない位置も確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep it beside you without protruding into the walkway. Let's also check a position where it will not fall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチの外へ立て掛けず、座ったまま手が届く所へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を妨げず届く位置へ置くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not lean it outside the bench, but put it where I can reach while seated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will put it within reach without blocking passage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩後は杖とお荷物を確かめてから歩き出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After resting, check your cane and belongings before starting to walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。管理棟の横と覚えて、今日はそのベンチまでの往復にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチの場所を覚えて往復範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will remember that it is beside the management building and just walk out to that bench and back today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Remember the bench location and decide the extent of your walk. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲でどうぞ。お困りなら管理棟へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within your limits. If you have trouble, ask at the management building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えの案内が必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人とは乗換先のホームで会います。三両目の所で待てば分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車両位置で合流できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am meeting my friend on the connecting train's platform. Will we find each other if I wait by the third car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can meet using the car position. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車両の長さや停車位置が違う場合があります。固定された目印の方が伝わりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Car lengths and stopping positions can differ. A fixed landmark is easier to communicate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですか。ホームの階段のそばなら大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 固定目印として階段を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. Would near the platform stairs be okay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest the stairs as a fixed landmark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 階段は複数あります。案内図では、この待合室の入口が区別しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are several stairways. On the map, this waiting room entrance is easier to identify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人に「待合室の入口」と送ります。乗る方向も一緒に書いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合室と方面を併せて伝える必要を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will message my friend “waiting room entrance.” Should I also write the direction we are taking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to give both waiting room and direction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。反対方向のホームにも待合室がありますから、方面も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The opposite-direction platform also has a waiting room, so include the direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 方面名と待合室を伝えました。合流前に列車が来ても、私だけ先に乗らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡済みの目印と先に乗らない方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have sent the direction name and waiting room. Even if a train arrives before we meet, I will not board ahead by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the landmark you sent and your plan not to board ahead. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方が行き違いを防げます。人の流れを避けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That helps avoid missing each other. Please wait out of the flow of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人そろってから列車を選びます。乗換の通路もこの図で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で列車を選び通路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will choose a train once we are both there. I will also check the transfer passage on this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a train together and check the passage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが通路です。合流に余裕を持ってご移動ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the passage. Please allow plenty of time to get to your meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書は二通をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like two copies of the certificate, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一通は会社、一通は学校です。同じものを二通ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの提出先へ同じ証明書を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One for my company, one for school. Please give me two of the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the same certificate for two recipients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの提出先は、記載内容を指定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does each recipient specify what should be included?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社は私だけ、学校は世帯全員と書いてあります。同じ内容ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人のみと世帯全員という指定の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The company says just me; school says all household members. So they are not the same contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between yourself only and the whole household. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの指定を分けて申請しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's apply separately according to each specification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二通という数だけを伝えていました。申請書も分けて書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請の書き分け方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only mentioned the number, two copies. Do I also need to fill out separate applications?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to fill out the applications separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの記入方法をご案内します。どちらの用途か分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain how to fill this out. Make it clear which purpose each is for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社用は本人一人、学校用は世帯全員として、指定の紙を別々に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先と記載範囲を別々の資料で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the instruction papers separate: company for me alone, school for all household members.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show recipients and coverage using separate documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 氏名や住所なども、それぞれの申請で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check name, address and other details on each application too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記載範囲を確認できました。受け取る時も、二通が同じと思わず提出先ごとに見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時も用途ごとに内容を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed the coverage. When collecting them, I will check each recipient's copy rather than assume both are the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the contents by purpose at collection too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの指定に沿った申請として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the applications according to those two specifications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で書きにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything hard to fill out on the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「空腹時」の意味が分かりません。今お腹がすいているか、という質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空腹時の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand “fasting.” Is it asking whether I feel hungry now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what fasting means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食事を取っていない状態を指しますが、この欄の答え方は看護師が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means not having eaten, but the nurse will check how to answer this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝七時にパンを食べ、八時に牛乳を飲みました。今は何も食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に食べ飲みした内容と時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I ate bread at seven this morning and drank milk at eight. I am not eating anything now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State what and when you last ate and drank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時刻と内容を、そのまま看護師へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the nurse those exact times and contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 牛乳は食事ではないと思っていましたが、飲んだことも書いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 牛乳も記載するか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought milk was not a meal. Should I write that I drank it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether to record the milk too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。飲み物も含め、分かる事実を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Record the facts you know, including drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「七時にパン、八時に牛乳」と書きます。空腹時かどうかは勝手に丸を付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事実を記入し分類判断を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write “bread at seven, milk at eight.” I will not mark fasting or not on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the facts and defer the classification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その欄は確認待ちにして看護師へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will leave that field pending confirmation and connect you with the nurse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。検査のために今から食事を抜くかも、看護師に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査準備を看護師に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I also want to ask the nurse whether I should skip meals from now for the test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm test preparation with the nurse. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認します。自己判断で準備を変えず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check. Do not change your preparations on your own; please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な連絡についてのご相談ですね。どのような内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a suspicious message, correct? What does it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日、代引きの荷物が来るというメッセージです。私は注文していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文していない代引き予告を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A message says a cash-on-delivery package will come tomorrow. I have not ordered anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the cash-on-delivery notice for an order you did not place. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 家族の注文の可能性は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked whether a family member might have ordered it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻はまだ仕事中で聞けていません。差出人名も注文番号も書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族への確認状況と欠けた情報を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wife is still at work, so I have not asked. There is no sender's name or order number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State whether you have checked with family and what information is missing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からない段階で、メッセージのリンクから支払う必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: While you do not know, you do not need to pay through the message's link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りの前に妻へ聞きます。荷物が来たら、確認できるまで支払わずに配達員へ説明してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認前の配達対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my wife before receiving it. If it comes, may I explain to the delivery person without paying until I can confirm?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle delivery before confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 心当たりが未確認と伝え、配送会社の正規窓口で取扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Say you have not confirmed whether it is expected, and check handling with the delivery company's official contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「家族に確認中なので、今は支払えません」と伝えます。届いた物もすぐ開けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払いを保留する言い方を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will say “I am checking with my family, so I cannot pay now.” I will not open delivered items straight away either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare wording for withholding payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メッセージの画面は保存されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you saved the message screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。受信時刻も残しました。妻の確認結果と実際の配達の有無を分けて、また相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メッセージ保存と追加確認の方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I saved the reception time too. I will consult again, separating my wife's confirmation result from whether delivery actually occurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your plan for saving the message and further checks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今分かっている内容を伺い、相談先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hear what you currently know and guide you to a consultation contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱の中には何が入っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 服と、未使用の消臭スプレーです。まとめて友人へ送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 衣類とスプレーを同梱したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Clothes and an unused deodorizing spray. I want to send them together to a friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you packed clothes and spray together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: スプレーは缶でしょうか。中身の表示を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the spray in a can? May I see the contents label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この缶です。未使用なら問題ないと思って、衣類の間に入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用の缶を示して認識を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This can. I thought unused would be okay, so I placed it among the clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the unused can and explain your understanding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未使用かどうかだけでは判断できません。成分と配送条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot judge solely from whether it is unused. We will check ingredients and shipping conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 缶を取り出して見せます。服だけなら先に送れるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 缶を取り出し衣類単独の発送を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take the can out to show you. Please also tell me whether I can send just the clothes first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Take out the can and ask about sending clothes alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 服だけの箱については別に確認できます。缶の発送可否は担当の判断をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the clothes-only box separately. Please wait for the responsible staff's decision about shipping the can.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分けます。品名欄に「日用品」とだけ書いたのも、衣類とスプレーだと書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 具体的な品名へ記載を直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will separate them. I also want to rewrite the contents field from just “daily necessities” to clothes and spray.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the description to specific item names. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。具体的な内容を記載してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please describe the contents specifically.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は衣類の箱だけを相談し、スプレーは持ち帰ります。発送できる物か改めて調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 衣類のみ送り缶の条件を別に調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will ask only about the clothes box and take the spray home. I will check again whether it can be shipped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send only the clothes and check the can's conditions separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。衣類の梱包と宛先を確認して受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the clothes' packaging and destination and accept the shipment.
